country.name: Uruguay
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Lengua de Señas Uruguaya (LSU) is legally recognized as the natural language of deaf people and their communities; accessible communication and any additional community language support require institutional and community review.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Uruguayan reviewer, current authoritative sources and review by the responsible education authority, institution or program owner.

governanceModel.summary: Uruguay separates education responsibilities. ANEP is the autonomous public authority for initial, primary, secondary, technical-professional and teacher education within its remit. MEC coordinates national education policy and information and administers authorization and recognition processes for private tertiary education and specified public tertiary programs. Universidad de la República and Universidad Tecnológica are autonomous public universities and are not subordinate to MEC in the same way as private tertiary institutions.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: Administración Nacional de Educación Pública and Ministerio de Educación y Cultura within their respective legal competences
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the center identifier, name, subsystem, level, modality, administration type, department, locality, services offered, source update date and review date. A directory record does not prove that every service is current.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Autonomous public-university status, private-institution authorization, recognition of a specific career and plan, title registration, and time-limited program accreditation are separate claims.

authorities.name: Administración Nacional de Educación Pública (ANEP)
authorities.role: autonomous public authority for the national public education system within its statutory remit

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación y Cultura — Dirección Nacional de Educación
authorities.role: education coordination, national information and tertiary-education functions assigned by law

authorities.name: Direcciones Generales and Consejo de Formación en Educación of ANEP
authorities.role: administration of the relevant education subsystems and current implementation guidance

authorities.name: Universidad de la República
authorities.role: autonomous public university responsible for its academic governance

authorities.name: Universidad Tecnológica
authorities.role: autonomous public technological university responsible for its academic governance

authorities.name: Unidad Reguladora y de Control de Datos Personales (URCDP)
Instituto del Niño y Adolescente del Uruguay (INAU)
authorities.role: child and adolescent protection authority within its legal remit

curriculum.title: Marco Curricular Nacional, progresiones de aprendizaje and current EBI and EMS plans and programs
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm subsystem, level, grade, space or unit, governing resolution, document version, effective school year, current adjustments and institution-specific implementation before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never silently replace the applicable ANEP curricular document, current program, resolution, teacher guidance or approved institutional plan.

schoolDirectory.authority: ANEP through SIGANEP and the responsible subsystem
schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Sistema de Información Geográfica de ANEP — SIGANEP
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: SIGANEP locates centers and educational offers, but the published interface identifies different update dates by subsystem. A map or directory result does not by itself prove that every center, level, modality or service is currently operating.

educationStatistics.authority: ANEP — Departamento de Investigación y Estadística Educativa
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display reference year, publication or update date, measure, population, subsystem, geography, source and filters. Series must retain methodological notes and must not be presented as current-year counts unless the source says so.

higherEducation.authorityNotice: Authorization of a private institution, recognition of a particular career, plan, site and modality, autonomous status of a public university, title registration, and a program's time-limited ARCU-SUR accreditation are distinct. ARCU-SUR accreditation must not be presented as universal institutional accreditation.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Ley N.º 18.331 de Protección de Datos Personales y Acción de Habeas Data, as amended and regulated
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Unidad Reguladora y de Control de Datos Personales
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenLaw: Código de la Niñez y la Adolescencia, Ley N.º 17.823, as amended
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Lawful basis, transparency, purpose limitation, security, data-subject rights, child participation and authorization, safeguarding, incident handling and institution-specific protocols require qualified Uruguayan review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Lengua de Señas Uruguaya must be treated as a recognized natural language of deaf people and their communities, not as a Spanish translation feature. Accessibility, interpretation and language support must be designed with competent institutions and affected communities; automatic translation is not reviewed localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Uruguayan education reviewer is named.
ANEP, MEC, subsystem, autonomous-university and institution responsibilities are correctly assigned for every claim.
Every center record preserves identifier, subsystem, level, modality, geography, offered services, source update date and review date.
SIGANEP's differing subsystem update dates are visible and old directory data is not presented as current operation.
Every statistic shows reference year, update date, definition, population, subsystem, geography, filters and provenance.

Every higher-education claim distinguishes autonomous public status, private institutional authorization, career recognition, plan, site, modality, title registration and time-limited program accreditation.
Curriculum mappings identify subsystem, level, unit, governing resolution, version, effective year and current adjustments.
LSU accessibility and communication are reviewed with competent institutions and affected communities.
Privacy, child safeguarding, accessibility, incident and authorization procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, recognition, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
